This is a character analysis/comparison task with relatively clear completion criteria (listing traits for two specific characters in a hypothetical spar scenario). While it has a creative framing, it's primarily an extraction/retrieval task drawing on knowledge of existing fictional characters. Willet performs best on well-specified tasks and leads on Creative Generation evals despite its preference aversion, making it well-suited here.

This is a creative character comparison/analysis task involving fictional characters from entertainment media. While it has some generative latitude, it's relatively structured (listing traits for a hypothetical spar scenario). The models are effectively tied on creative generation within variance, and Lapwing's stronger Policy & Moderation score is a minor advantage since the query involves a fight scenario — though it's clearly benign fiction. Either model would handle this well, but Lapwing is a reasonable choice.
